Actual Article Body:
This poorly built RDP home had its roof blown off during recent high winds in the township of Agisanang near Sannieshof in Tswaing Local Municipality, North West province.

Agnes Maropeng has lived in a corrugated iron shack for over 35 years in the informal settlement of Skierlek in Delareyville in the North West province.

Maropeng said her family and dozens of her neighbours in the beleaguered Tswaing Local Municipality have been promised housing, water and sanitation for decades.

Her street is flooded with raw sewage. The stench hangs over several blocks. “It is disgusting. I feel embarrassed living like this,” said Maropeng.

Carrying her toddler daughter on her back, she walks about three kilometres a day to collect water in buckets.

Rabid and fanatical anti-male bigotry is nothing new in the Democratic Party. It has arguably existed for decades and been a core tenet of third-wave and fourth-wave feminism. Over the years, as feminism has fused with radical left-wing ideologies and contemporary cultural Bolshevism, it has mutated from a movement for women’s equal rights into one that embraces a fanatical hatred of men and blames all of society’s ills on them.
